name: Shiiku x Kanojo
source:
The protagonist, living a reclusive life, fell for Natsuko Oominato, the girl working at the local convenience store.  
Though he wanted to get closer to her, he was content just to watch from afar.  
However, his peaceful days have come to an end when Natsuko suddenly got a boyfriend.  
And it didn’t stop there—he found out the guy was quite the player.  
To make matters worse, this jerk was growing tired of Natsuko and even nudging his friends to pursue her.  
Feeling the pressure, the protagonist decided to ambush Natsuko after her shift and desperately tried to convince her to break up with the guy.
But Natsuko just freaked out and ignored him completely. 
In a moment of desperation, he lost his grip on reality and impulsively dragged her into his room.

"What am I doing... but if I let her go now, that guy will..."  
“Right... if she’s going to get messed up by that loser anyway, then it’s better I do it instead!..”  
And so began their bizarre “breeding co-living”—


[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=842087]getchu[/url]]
translation:
主人公过着隐居生活，爱上在当地便利店工作的大小凪夏子。虽然想接近她，却满足于远远观望。然而夏子突然交了男友，平静日子结束。不仅如此，主人公发现那男人是个花花公子。更糟的是，男人开始厌倦夏子，还怂恿朋友追求她。主人公感到压力，决定在夏子下班后埋伏，拼命劝她分手。夏子却惊慌失措，完全不理他。绝望之下，主人公失去现实感，一时冲动把她拖进房间。

“我在做什么……但现在放她走，那家伙会……”
“对，如果她反正要被那个失败者弄脏，不如由我来做！”

奇异的“繁殖同居”就此开始——
